title: Agents cannot run a Flow over the connector, so text-to-speech is unreachable from another repo
description: The connector's generate route requires modelId, and every Flow dispatches with model.id:null - so no Flow is reachable, including both TTS surfaces (flowChatterBox 'Text to Speech', flowDramaBox). Add flowId + fields + media to that route, stage the caller's own audio through the existing place-preview-asset route, and document both recipes in the cubric-vision skill so a sibling-repo agent (MadPony-Identity) can speak a line in a supplied voice.

attention.reason: Closed by Fabio 2026-08-31. The condition it was held on has been met: MadPony-Identity drove the connector's flow dispatch with his own voice reference and produced the whole THE FAILED HEIST follow-up narration as DramaBox takes.
